title: Settings
autonomy: Default autonomy level for new threads
autonomyHint: Autonomous execution within project scope; writes outside the project are still sandboxed and rollbackable.
toolDensityHint: Controls read/search tool group collapse: compact (always collapsed), balanced (collapsed, expandable), detailed (expanded).
notifHint: Control when system notifications are shown.
fontWeightHint: Adjust global font weight, effective immediately.
wallpaperHint: Setting a wallpaper activates translucent frosted glass (similar to macOS vibrancy). Stored locally only.
glassMode: Enable frosted glass (uses default gradient when no wallpaper is set)

permissionDirs.title: Directory Access
permissionDirs.desc: Codex-style standing grants: hand folders outside the workspace to the agent without per-operation approval prompts. A drive root (e.g. F:\ or /Volumes/Data) grants the whole drive. Only grant directories you trust the agent with.
permissionDirs.readDesc: The agent can read every file under these directories (no writes).
permissionDirs.writeDesc: The agent can read and modify every file under these directories. Write implies read.
permissionDirs.manualPlaceholder: or type an absolute directory path (~ supported)
permissionDirs.missing: Path does not exist (will be skipped)
permissionDirs.savedRestart: Saved · removed directories stay effective until the app restarts

computerUse.title: Computer Use
computerUse.desc: Let the agent see and operate desktop GUI apps (screenshot + accessibility tree + click/type). Each app's first action requires approval; apps you mark "always allow" are listed here.
computerUse.unavailable: Not supported on this platform (macOS and Windows only), or disabled via RIVET_COMPUTER_USE=0.
computerUse.grantsEmpty: No always-allowed apps yet. Check "always allow" on an approval card to add one.

updateCheckFailed: Update check failed: {{error}} (if you just configured signing, make sure pubkey and endpoint are set)
